_description: The obliquity beat table — GENERATED by tools/verify/obliquity-beat-table.js --write (plan 31 A2, doc 111 §1.44). The hybrid spin integration's beat band — the mean, min and max of its ε over one obliquity beat of date (the API's 41-sample instrument, obliquityBandAt's grid) — at every 1-Myr node of the engine axis over the navigable domain: nodes[k − kMin] = [meanDeg, minDeg, maxDeg] at the year 2000 + k × nodeYears. The drawn-scene obliquity rule (the cited mean of date carrying this band beyond the hybrid's ±10 Myr), the eclipse tier's ground mapping and the Genesis Analysis Obliquity Earth tab read it; a node is a RECORD of the instrument — the generator refuses unless a fresh model reproduces a spread of nodes bit-exactly, and the check mode (no --write) re-reads that spread against the file.
